answer: Propose auctioning 20 daily AI quoting slots shared by basalt and onyx markets, at a 2-credit reserve each. Validators verify distinct payments and bind each slot to one key in a finalized ledger; every order-book mirror rejects orders lacking that binding. Fees recur and are nonrefundable; servers are reusable capital; no stake. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse slots. Honest consensus is assumed; wealth can buy aliases or monopolize access. Ten active aliases need ten winning slots and at least 20 credits/day; extra keys cannot expand the 20-slot supply.
